broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains stable and correct: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No word-level changes. All three modules are compatible. Ready for final round.
tokenizer.js remains correct and unchanged. It calls injected normalize(text) and extracts tokens per spec. Ready for final integration.

pipeline.js remains unchanged and fully compliant. processText calls tokenize(text) once, builds frequencies with null prototype to handle keys like 'constructor', returns required structure. text is tokens joined by spaces. Ready for final round.

private_memories.normalizer: Round 3: normalize.js unchanged and correct. NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace, trim. No word changes. Peers' tokenizer and pipeline remain correct. My responsibility is normalize.js only. Final round: keep stable.
private_memories.tokenizer: Round 3: All files remain stable and correct. My tokenizer.js is unchanged. No issues detected. Final round: confirm no changes needed; ensure tokenizer.js exactly matches spec and does not shadow injected normalize.
private_memories.integrator: Round 3: pipeline.js unchanged and correct. Requirements: processText(text) calls injected tokenize(text), returns {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. text = tokens.join(' '). frequencies uses Object.create(null) to handle prototype names. No shadowing. No setup functions. Peers stable. Final round approaching; keep implementation as is.
